Coram : D.Y. CHANDRACHUD*, M.R. SHAH
Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016 – ss.5(26), 7, 9, 10, 12, 23, 25, 30, 31, 60(5), 61 & 74(3) – National Company Law Tribunal Rules, 2016 – r.11 – Insolvency and Bankruptcy Board of India (Insolvency Resolution Process regulations, 2016 – regn. 36A, 36B and 39 – Whether withdrawals or modifications by successful Resolution Applicants are permissible under IBC – Held: The framework, as it stands, only enables withdrawals from the CIRP process by following the procedure detailed in Section 12A
Decision Date : 13-09-2021 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3224/2020 | Disposal Nature : Disposed off | Bench : 2 Judges
